e.title: CRO Forum（首席风险官论坛）：20 年可筛选出版物档案与 AI 治理议题
e.title_en: The CRO Forum: a filterable twenty-year publication archive and AI governance topics
e.title_hk: CRO Forum（首席風險官論壇）：20 年可篩選出版物檔案與 AI 治理議題
e.summary: 欧洲大型保险与再保险公司首席风险官组成的论坛：出版物档案可按类别（风险管理最佳实践/新兴与长期风险洞察/监管要求下的风险管理）与年份（2005–2026）筛选，实测含 2026 年 AI 治理与合规议题
e.summary_en: A forum of chief risk officers from major European insurers and reinsurers: its publication archive is filterable by category (risk-management best practice; insights on emerging and long-term risks; risk management with respect to regulatory requirements) and by year (2005–2026), with measured 2026 material on AI governance and compliance
e.summary_hk: 歐洲大型保險與再保險公司首席風險官組成的論壇：出版物檔案可按類別（風險管理最佳實踐／新興與長期風險洞察／監管要求下的風險管理）與年份（2005–2026）篩選，實測含 2026 年 AI 治理與合規議題
e.body:
**CRO Forum（Chief Risk Officer Forum，首席风险官论坛）** 是**欧洲大型保险与再保险公司首席风险官组成的论坛**（站点标题实测 **「Home - The CRO Forum」**）。本条目补的是**「CRO 层级的从业者治理组织」这一形态**——⭐ **这里必须说清口径**：**池内「治理」并非空白**（实测已有 [[insurance-governance]]、[[three-lines-of-defense]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[lma-ai-governance]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[australia-ai6-governance]] 等）；**本条补的不是「治理」这个词，而是「由公司首席风险官自己组成、并连续 20 年输出风险议题的行业论坛」这一具体机构形态**（**实测池内此前为 0**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **首页 93.0KB，标题「Home - The CRO Forum」**；⭐ **「About CRO Forum」页 `/about-cro-forum/` 实测 67.7KB**；⭐ **「Publications（出版物）」页 `/category/publications/` 实测 99.7KB，标题「Publications Archives - The CRO Forum」**。**该页实测的筛选结构**：**Filter by Keyword**；⭐ **Filter by Category** 三档为 **「Best practices in risk management（风险管理最佳实践）」**、**「Insights on emerging and long-term risks（新兴与长期风险洞察）」**、**「Risk Management i.r.t regulatory requirements（监管要求下的风险管理）」**；⭐ **Filter by Year 实测覆盖 2026 至 2005**（**共约 22 年**）。**首页实测的当期议题**：⭐ **「AI Governance & Compliance」**，正文实测写明 **「Artificial intelligence is becoming increasingly embedded across the insurance value chain, creating significant opportunities for innovation, efficiency and improved decision-making. At the same time, AI introduces new governance, operational, conduct and third-party risks that require [...]」**，**并带实测时间戳 2026-08-12**。**导航实测**：Home、About us、Members、Publications、News、Contact。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「从业者视角的风险议题连续输出」这一层**——**池内风险议题的来源此前主要是监管者（[[eiopa-registers]]、[[ngfs]]）、学术（[[geneva-papers]]、[[astin-bulletin]]）与行业组织（[[geneva-association]]、[[insurance-europe]]）**，**而 CRO Forum 是「公司首席风险官本人」的集体声音**；**对做企业风险管理（ERM）方向的学生，「实务界的 CRO 在关心什么」与「监管者在要求什么」是两套不同的议程**（可与 [[insurance-governance]]、[[insurance-mrm]]、[[risk-management-ontology]]、[[ggsolvencyii]] 并读）。**② ⭐ 「2005–2026 共 22 年的可筛选档案」是本站少见的时间纵深**——**一个论坛能连续输出二十年，说明议题有生命周期而非一次性报告**；**按年份与类别交叉筛选，可以看出一类议题（如新兴风险）的兴衰曲线**——**这种「档案即研究材料」的用法，与 [[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 的长序列思路同源，只是议题而非数据**。**③ 三个类别本身就是一份 ERM 议题分类法**——**最佳实践 / 新兴与长期风险 / 监管要求**；**注意第三类的措辞「i.r.t regulatory requirements」（with respect to）**——**即它把「监管要求」当作风险管理的输入条件而非全部内容**，**这个立场与纯合规视角有区别**。**④ 实测当期议题是 AI 治理与合规，且时间戳为 2026-08-12**——**说明该论坛的产出是当期而非历史存量**；**可与池内 [[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]]、[[korea-ai-accountability]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 并读——那些是标准、监管态势与立场文件，这一条是行业 CRO 的集体议题**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与两个功能页的存在、标题、页面体量、筛选结构与年份跨度、以及当期议题的正文片段与时间戳**，**但未打开任何一份出版物正文**，因此**不能转述任何一份报告的内容、结论或建议**；**② 「由欧洲大型保险与再保险公司的首席风险官组成」这一表述依据机构名称与站点自述栏目（About us / Members）**，**本次未打开 Members 页核实成员名单与机构范围**——**故本词条不主张成员数量、成员公司名单或其地域范围**；**③ 「共约 22 年」由「Filter by Year 2026…2005」实测推得**，**但本次未核实 2005 与 2006 等早期年份是否确有出版物**（**筛选器列出年份不等于该年必有产出**）；**④ 「AI Governance & Compliance」的正文片段实测以「require [...]」截断**——**故词条内只引用到该处为止，不补全其后的内容**；**⑤ CRO Forum 的法定地位（是否为协会、是否设在某国）、其与 [[geneva-association]]、[[insurance-europe]] 的关系本次未核实**；**⑥ 站点为 WordPress 建站**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** CRO Forum 提供精算软件、模型或可下载数据**。**核实说明**：首页（93.0KB）、`/about-cro-forum/`（67.7KB）、`/category/publications/`（99.7KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取筛选结构与议题片段；**未打开 Members 页、未打开任何出版物正文**。
e.body_en:
**The CRO Forum (Chief Risk Officer Forum)** is **a forum of chief risk officers from major European insurers and reinsurers** (measured site title **"Home - The CRO Forum"**). This entry adds the **"CRO-level practitioner governance body"** form — ⭐ **and the scope must be stated precisely**: **"governance" is not a blank in the corpus** (measured items include [[insurance-governance]], [[three-lines-of-defense]], [[governance-mcp]], [[iso-42001-toolkit]], [[lma-ai-governance]], [[irdai-ai-governance]] and [[australia-ai6-governance]]); **what this entry adds is not the word "governance" but the specific institutional form of "an industry forum formed by companies’ own chief risk officers that has published on risk topics for twenty consecutive years"** (**measured zero before this entry**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **homepage is 93.0KB with the measured title "Home - The CRO Forum"**; ⭐ the **"About CRO Forum" page measures 67.7KB**; ⭐ the **"Publications" page `/category/publications/` measures 99.7KB with the title "Publications Archives - The CRO Forum"**. **The filtering structure measured on that page**: **Filter by Keyword**; ⭐ **Filter by Category** with three options — **"Best practices in risk management"**, **"Insights on emerging and long-term risks"** and **"Risk Management i.r.t regulatory requirements"**; ⭐ **Filter by Year measurably spans 2026 down to 2005** (**about 22 years**). **The current topic measured on the homepage**: ⭐ **"AI Governance & Compliance"**, with body text reading **"Artificial intelligence is becoming increasingly embedded across the insurance value chain, creating significant opportunities for innovation, efficiency and improved decision-making. At the same time, AI introduces new governance, operational, conduct and third-party risks that require [...]"**, **carrying a measured timestamp of 2026-08-12**. **Measured navigation**: Home, About us, Members, Publications, News, Contact.

For RIAA: **① it adds a layer of continuous practitioner-authored risk topics** — **the corpus’s risk agenda has come mainly from supervisors ([[eiopa-registers]], [[ngfs]]), academia ([[geneva-papers]], [[astin-bulletin]]) and trade bodies ([[geneva-association]], [[insurance-europe]])**, **whereas the CRO Forum is the collective voice of companies’ own chief risk officers**; **for students working on enterprise risk management, "what practitioners’ CROs care about" and "what supervisors require" are two different agendas** (readable with [[insurance-governance]], [[insurance-mrm]], [[risk-management-ontology]] and [[ggsolvencyii]]). **② ⭐ A filterable archive spanning 2005–2026, about 22 years, is unusual temporal depth here** — **a forum sustaining output for two decades indicates topics with life cycles rather than one-off reports**; **cross-filtering by year and category reveals the rise and fall of a topic class such as emerging risks** — **this "archive as research material" use parallels the long-series thinking of [[cmi-mortality-projections]] and [[human-mortality-db]], only in topics rather than data**. **③ The three categories are themselves an ERM topic taxonomy** — **best practice / emerging and long-term risk / regulatory requirements**; **note the third one’s wording, "i.r.t regulatory requirements" (with respect to)** — **it treats regulatory requirements as an input to risk management rather than the whole of it**, **a stance distinct from a purely compliance-driven view**. **④ The measured current topic is AI governance and compliance, timestamped 2026-08-12** — **indicating current rather than historical output**; **readable with [[iso-42001-toolkit]], [[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]], [[korea-ai-accountability]] and [[aae-ai-act-position]] — those are standards, regulatory postures and position papers; this is the collective agenda of industry CROs**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and two functional pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the filtering structure and year span, and a body fragment and timestamp for the current topic**, **but opened no publication body**, so **no report’s content, conclusion or recommendation can be restated**; **② the statement that it comprises chief risk officers of major European insurers and reinsurers rests on the body’s name and its own section labels (About us / Members)**, **and the Members page was not opened to verify the roster or institutional scope** — **so this entry claims no member count, company list or geographic scope**; **③ "about 22 years" is inferred from the measured "Filter by Year 2026…2005"**, **but whether early years such as 2005 and 2006 actually contain publications was not verified** (**a year listed in a filter does not prove output in that year**); **④ the "AI Governance & Compliance" body fragment measurably truncates at "require [...]"** — **so the entry quotes no further and does not complete it**; **⑤ the CRO Forum’s legal status (whether an association, and where registered) and its relationship to [[geneva-association]] and [[insurance-europe]] were not verified**; **⑥ the site runs on WordPress**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the CRO Forum provides actuarial software, models or downloadable data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (93.0KB), `/about-cro-forum/` (67.7KB) and `/category/publications/` (99.7KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with the filtering structure and topic fragment read verbatim; **no Members page and no publication body was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**CRO Forum（Chief Risk Officer Forum，首席風險官論壇）** 是**歐洲大型保險與再保險公司首席風險官組成的論壇**（標題實測 **「Home - The CRO Forum」**）。本條目補的是**「CRO 層級的從業者治理組織」這一形態**——⭐ **這裡必須說清口徑**：**池內「治理」並非空白**（實測已有 [[insurance-governance]]、[[three-lines-of-defense]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[lma-ai-governance]] 等）；**本條補的不是「治理」這個詞，而是「由公司首席風險官自己組成、並連續 20 年輸出風險議題的行業論壇」這一具體機構形態**（**實測此前為 0**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **首頁 93.0KB**；⭐ **「About CRO Forum」頁 67.7KB**；⭐ **「Publications」頁 99.7KB**。**該頁實測篩選結構**：**Filter by Keyword**；⭐ **Filter by Category** 三檔為 **「Best practices in risk management」／「Insights on emerging and long-term risks」／「Risk Management i.r.t regulatory requirements」**；⭐ **Filter by Year 實測覆蓋 2026 至 2005**（**約 22 年**）。**首頁實測當期議題**：⭐ **「AI Governance & Compliance」**，正文實測 **「Artificial intelligence is becoming increasingly embedded across the insurance value chain, creating significant opportunities for innovation, efficiency and improved decision-making. At the same time, AI introduces new governance, operational, conduct and third-party risks that require [...]」**，**帶實測時間戳 2026-08-12**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「從業者視角的風險議題連續輸出」**——**池內風險議題來源此前主要是監管者、學術與行業組織，而 CRO Forum 是「公司首席風險官本人」的集體聲音**；**對做 ERM 方向的學生，「實務界 CRO 在關心什麼」與「監管者在要求什麼」是兩套議程**。**② ⭐ 「2005–2026 共約 22 年的可篩選檔案」是本站少見的時間縱深**——**按年份與類別交叉篩選，可看出一類議題的興衰曲線**——**這種「檔案即研究材料」與 [[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 的長序列思路同源**。**③ 三個類別本身就是一份 ERM 議題分類法**；**注意第三類措辭「i.r.t regulatory requirements」——它把監管要求當作風險管理的輸入條件而非全部**。**④ 實測當期議題是 AI 治理與合規，時間戳 2026-08-12**——**可與 [[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與兩個功能頁的存在、標題、體量、篩選結構與年份跨度、以及當期議題的正文片段與時間戳**，**但未打開任何一份出版物正文**，故**不能轉述任何報告的內容、結論或建議**；**② 「由歐洲大型保險與再保險公司首席風險官組成」依據機構名稱與站點自述欄目**，**本次未打開 Members 頁核實成員名單**——**故不主張成員數量、名單或地域範圍**；**③ 「約 22 年」由實測篩選器年份推得**，**但未核實 2005 等早期年份是否確有出版物**（**篩選器列出年份不等於該年必有產出**）；**④ 議題正文片段實測以「require [...]」截斷，故詞條內只引用到該處為止**；**⑤ 其法定地位與與 [[geneva-association]]、[[insurance-europe]] 的關係未核實**；**⑥ 站點為 WordPress 建站**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** CRO Forum 提供精算軟件、模型或可下載數據**。**核實說明**：三個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取篩選結構與議題片段；**未打開 Members 頁與任何出版物正文**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（首页 93.0KB 标题「Home - The CRO Forum」；⭐/about-cro-forum/ 67.7KB 标题「About CRO Forum - The CRO Forum」；⭐/category/publications/ 99.7KB 标题「Publications Archives - The CRO Forum」，实测筛选结构 Filter by Keyword + Filter by Category 三档（Best practices in risk management / Insights on emerging and long-term risks / Risk Management i.r.t regulatory requirements）+ Filter by Year 2026…2005；首页实测当期议题「AI Governance & Compliance」正文含「Artificial intelligence is becoming increasingly embedded across the insurance value chain…AI introduces new governance, operational, conduct and third-party risks that require [...]」（截断处即止）并带时间戳 2026-08-12；导航实测 Home/About us/Members/Publications/News/Contact）+ ★池内「治理」非空白（已有 insurance-governance、three-lines-of-defense、governance-mcp、iso-42001-toolkit、lma-ai-governance 等），本条目补的是「CRO 层级的从业者论坛」这一机构形态（此前 0），已在词条内写明口径；未打开 Members 页与任何出版物正文；未核实成员名单、早期年份是否确有产出、法定地位
